items.title: Towards Effective Process Supervision in Mathematical Reasoning
items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Introduction In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable advances in mathematical reasoning, yet they can make mistakes, such as miscalculations or logical errors, leading to wrong conclusions. Moreover, even when achieving correct final answers, these powerful models can still regularly make up plausible reasoning steps, where the final answers build upon
items.summaryZh: 该技术文章聚焦于大语言模型在数学推理中的过程监督机制。大模型在解题时常出现中间步骤计算错误或逻辑漏洞，过程监督方法能够对推理的每一步进行有效纠错和评估，从而显著提升复杂推理任务中的可信度与准确性。原始信息显示：GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Introduction In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable advances in mathematical reasoning, yet they can make mistakes, such as miscalculations or logical errors, leading to wrong conclusions.
